Enabled.Name: Enable strict Fog Exploration policy
Enabled.Hint: When enabled, managed world Scenes must have Fog Exploration disabled.

RepairOnReady.Name: Repair existing Scenes when the world loads
RepairOnReady.Hint: The active GM performs an idempotent, batched repair after world startup.

EnforceCreates.Name: Enforce on newly created and imported Scenes
EnforceCreates.Hint: New world Scenes are persisted with Fog Exploration disabled, including Scenes imported from compendiums.

EnforceUpdates.Name: Prevent managed Scenes from re-enabling Fog Exploration
EnforceUpdates.Hint: Attempts to enable Fog Exploration on a managed Scene are corrected before the update is stored.

AllowExemptions.Name: Allow per-Scene exemptions
AllowExemptions.Hint: Allows the dashboard to exempt selected world Scenes from the strict policy.

NotifyAutomaticRepair.Name: Notify me after automatic repair
NotifyAutomaticRepair.Hint: Shows a GM notification when this client, as active GM, repairs Scenes at startup.

Help.Title: Runyth Fog Policy — Dashboard Help
Help.Heading: Using the Fog Policy Dashboard
Help.Intro: The dashboard is designed for fast bulk work: narrow the Scene list, select the intended Scenes, then run one policy action. Search, quick filters, and the folder tree combine rather than replacing one another.

Workflow.Title: Recommended workflow
Workflow.Step1: Use the search field and quick filters to narrow the Scene list.
Workflow.Step2: Open Scene Folders only when folder scoping is useful. Folder selection can include all descendants.
Workflow.Step3: Use Select all filtered, Invert filtered selection, or individual Scene checkboxes to build the exact target set.
Workflow.Step4: Run Repair, Exempt, Manage, Purge, or a backup/import-export operation on that target set.

Filters.Title: Search and filters
Filters.Body: All search terms use AND semantics. Quotes keep multi-word values together. Quick filters and Scene-folder filters are applied in addition to the text query.
Filters.Name: Scene names containing the value.
Filters.Status: Policy status such as compliant, repair/non-compliant, or exempt.
Filters.Exempt: Whether the Scene is exempt from the policy.
Filters.Folders: The Scene Folders button opens a virtualized hierarchical list. The list is safe for large folder trees and can be searched independently. "Include nested folders" expands selected folders to all descendants.

Actions.Title: Bulk actions
Actions.Repair: Disables Fog Exploration on the selected managed Scenes. Failed Scene updates are isolated so one bad Scene does not discard successful updates.
Actions.Exempt: Marks the selected Scenes as policy exemptions when exemptions are enabled.
Actions.Manage: Removes exemptions so the strict policy applies to the selected Scenes again.
Actions.Purge: Permanently deletes stored FogExploration records for the selected Scenes and users. This is destructive and separate from merely disabling Fog Exploration.

Transfer.Title: Backup, import/export, and selection transfer
Transfer.Body: Expand the Backup/import-export section only when needed. Export targets can be the selected Scenes or all currently filtered Scenes.
Transfer.Backup: Backup files can include Scene policy state and optional world policy settings.
Transfer.Selection: Selection files contain Scene identity/folder metadata only and never change Scene settings by themselves.
Transfer.CrossWorld: Same-world imports prefer Scene IDs. Cross-world imports only use a unique exact name + folder-path fallback; ambiguous Scenes are never guessed.

Purge.Title: Purge safety
Purge.Body: A policy backup can restore Fog Exploration settings and exemptions, but it cannot reconstruct Foundry fog textures after FogExploration records are purged. Use a real Foundry World/data backup when historical explored-map data may need to be recovered.

Window.Title: Window size and position
Window.Body: Dashboard size and position are stored as a client-only preference. They are restored on the same browser/client and clamped to the current viewport so a monitor or resolution change cannot strand the window off-screen.
